title: Repair a secret-redaction implementation after raw hidden-test feedback

source.failure: The seed passes its public sk-credential test and fails the operator-only Bearer/access_token verifier.

objective: Ensure persisted mission and worker text redacts OpenAI-style sk- credentials while leaving surrounding diagnostic text useful. Add focused tests and preserve existing public function signatures.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAI-style sk- credentials are redacted from persisted text.
Non-secret diagnostic text and URL structure remain readable.
Focused public tests cover the required redaction behavior.
Existing public function signatures remain unchanged.

repair_injection.purpose: Run a real deterministic verifier outside the copied target so session-resume and raw-evidence handoff can be compared.
repair_injection.additional_acceptance: Redact Bearer token values and access_token query parameter values without removing the whole diagnostic line or URL.
